title: Add token cost advisory to OpenCode plugin
body:
## Summary

Add a token cost advisory system to the aidevops OpenCode plugin (`ttsr.mjs`) that warns users when session context exceeds 200k tokens, then every 50k above that.

## Motivation

Sessions on large-context models (Gemini 1M+) or with autocompact disabled can accumulate hundreds of thousands of tokens without the user realising the cost is escalating. Each interaction becomes more expensive as context grows. A proactive nudge to use `/compact` saves money with no loss of conversation understanding.

## Implementation

- Inject a synthetic message into the `messagesTransformHook` when the last assistant message's token total crosses 200k, 250k, 300k, etc.
- The LLM relays the advisory to the user naturally in its next response
- Per-session dedup prevents repeating within the same bracket
- No OpenCode core changes required — pure plugin-side feature

## Files changed

- `.agents/plugins/opencode-aidevops/ttsr.mjs`
